mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM room_inventory_detail WHERE inventory_id = #{inventoryId} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT d.id, d.inventory_id AS inventoryId, d.room_type_id AS roomTypeId, d.room_id AS roomId, d.status, d.is_occupied AS occupied, d.checkin_record_id AS checkinId FROM room_inventory_detail d JOIN room_type_inventory i ON i.id = d.inventory_id WHERE d.is_deleted = 0 AND d.inventory_id IN #{id} AND d.room_id IN #{id} ORDER BY i.stay_date, d.room_id
mapper.update: UPDATE room_inventory_detail SET is_occupied = 1, checkin_record_id = #{checkinId} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND is_occupied = 0 AND checkin_record_id IS NULL AND is_deleted = 0
